scope: Bounded self-review of the SDK legacy key acknowledgment repair
invariants: Marker is queued after the fallback key in the originating toolkit FIFO; no owner/widget calls from Cocoa callbacks
Cocoa fallback persists until owner acknowledgment and coherent text/selection publication; new keys cannot use old native baseline
Bounded queue refusal leaves a pending marker; subsequent publication retries without blocking/spinning or losing the already forwarded legacy key
Only an empty, client-zero, non-delta marker with valid zero/unmarked fields is admitted; malformed mutation payloads refuse
Driver acknowledges a marker without decoding/mutating text, replacing shadows or weakening existing expected-text/epoch/document/run/command guards
Legacy Enter and controlled field delivery retain their ordinary paths; old native input and document/capture ownership tests remain required
No provider, account, network call, model, project format or public command is introduced
limits: No full IME/reader/physical held/concurrent/blur or visible-p95 claim
Native replay is development candidate against old packaged agent; clean copied replacement qualification remains separate
Marker traffic adds one bounded metadata record per fallback key; no native latency/performance claim
